# Motive11

> Motive11 is Mark Szymanski's company in Pittsburgh, PA. One person plus AI, building custom software, AI systems, and websites for established firms whose people lose hours every week to busywork.

## Pages

- [Home](https://motive11.com/): what Motive11 does and who it's for
- [Services](https://motive11.com/services): Fractional AI and Systems Lead, the AI Onboarding Day, Website + Care, and custom software, with prices
- [Fractional AI and Systems Lead](https://motive11.com/fractional): the main offer, Mark as a business's AI and systems lead every month, with versions for engineering firms, law firms, and home services
- [AI Onboarding Day](https://motive11.com/ai-onboarding-day): one day to set up AI around how a business works
- [Case studies](https://motive11.com/case-studies): engineering, law, insurance, landscaping, nonprofit, and software clients
- [About](https://motive11.com/about): Mark Szymanski and how he works
- [Book an intro call](https://motive11.com/book/intro): a 20-minute first call

## Elsewhere
